description: This file defines the LocaleSettingsForm class for configuring locale settings in a Drupal site, including update intervals, translation sources, and import behaviors.

classes.name: LocaleSettingsForm
classes.description: A form class for managing locale and translation settings in Drupal.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns the configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for locale settings.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form input, ensuring local translation directory is set if local source is selected.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, clearing translation cache if source setting changes.
